name: deskport
description: This computer's screen and a persistent terminal in the browser, behind Cloudflare Access.

scripts.check: for f in hub/*.js shim/*.js src/*.js web/*.js web/js/*.js bench/*.mjs bench/lib/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && sh -n bin/xdg-open && python3 -m py_compile scripts/session-scale.py scripts/session-systemd-proxy.py scripts/monitor-config.py scripts/video-encoder.py
